cat.name: CAT 2026
cat.overview: CAT is India's most prestigious management entrance exam conducted by the IIMs. It evaluates a candidate's quantitative, verbal, and logical reasoning skills for admission into top-tier MBA programs across the country.

process.title: Registration
process.desc: Fill the online application form and upload documents.

process.title: Fee Payment
process.desc: Pay the registration fee of ₹2400 (₹1200 for SC/ST).

process.title: Admit Card
process.desc: Download admit card from the official CAT website.

process.title: Examination
process.desc: Appear for the CBT at the designated center.

process.title: Results & WAT-PI
process.desc: Shortlisted candidates appear for WAT and PI rounds.

tips.title: Mock Tests are Key
tips.desc: Take at least 30-40 full-length mock tests before the actual exam to build stamina and identify weak areas.

tips.title: Focus on Accuracy
tips.desc: With a +3/-1 marking scheme, accuracy is more important than the number of attempts.

tips.title: Read Extensively
tips.desc: Improve your VARC score by reading diverse articles from sources like Aeon, The Economist, and ALD.

faqs.q: What is the eligibility criteria for CAT?
faqs.a: A bachelor's degree with at least 50% marks or equivalent CGPA (45% for SC/ST/PwD candidates).
Yes, candidates appearing for the final year of their bachelor's degree can also apply.
A basic on-screen calculator is provided during the exam. Physical calculators are strictly prohibited.
